name: cogover-sdk-samples
description: Runnable samples for every public API of @cogover/sdk: one file per HTTP route, plus record triggers.

scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch local --ext ts --signal SIGTERM --exec "./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --import tsx local/cli.ts --entry ./src/main.ts || exit 1"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run coverage
